cohort: The study included 5342 cases of orofacial clefts among 7,301,636 live births in Sao Paulo state, Brazil, from 2008-2019.
finding: The overall prevalence of orofacial clefts was 7.3/10,000 live births in Sao Paulo state, Brazil, showing a stationary trend from 2008-2019, with the highest prevalence in mothers aged >=35 years and seasonal variation based on conception date in the spring.
cross-section timing: Data was collected for live births between 2008 and 2019, analyzed for prevalence and trends over this period.
gest_age: At term for 77.8% of OFC cases
